about: Will's own requests on the real June 14 leaf epidermis recording (the old voice's basics: name it, segment the thing he means, enlarge it, move to the other one, a reference picture, every cell, the average). Played as the camera; no setup.

steps.say: What's the thing in the middle?

expect.judge: names the oval in the middle as most likely a stoma (guard cells around a pore) in a leaf epidermis and points at it

steps.say: Use a segmentation model on the center thing.

expect.visible: the stoma in the middle outlined
expect.judge: outlines the oval in the middle within a couple of seconds and says so once, plainly

expect.visible: a magnifier showing the outlined stoma
expect.judge: opens a magnified view of the thing it just outlined and says so once

steps.say: Now show me the one on the left instead.

expect.visible: the oval on the left outlined and magnified
expect.judge: finds the other oval on the left, outlines it and moves the magnified view to it

steps.say: Pull up a reference image of a stoma.

expect.visible: a reference photo of a stoma
expect.judge: shows a real reference photo of a stoma and says what it is

expect.visible: the cells outlined as a layer
expect.judge: outlines the cells in view and says how many, once
gives the mean size of the outlined cells with its unit, not a median
